annotation.title_clean: Model Artificial Intelligence Governance Framework (Second Edition)
annotation.title_en: Model Artificial Intelligence Governance Framework (Second Edition)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Info-communications Media Development Authority (IMDA) and Personal Data Protection Commission (PDPC), Singapore
annotation.summary_en: Singapore's voluntary Model AI Governance Framework (2nd edition, 2020) from IMDA and PDPC gives organisations practical guidance on responsible AI deployment: internal governance, determining human involvement in AI-augmented decisions, operations and data management, and stakeholder communication, with industry examples. It is sector-agnostic and has no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Two guiding principles: AI decisions should be explainable, transparent and fair; AI should be human-centric.
Classifies human involvement as human-in-the-loop, out-of-the-loop or over-the-loop, using a probability-severity of harm matrix.
Recommends internal governance structures, clear roles, risk management and internal controls for AI.
Sets data accountability practices: lineage, quality, bias mitigation, separate training/test/validation sets.
Voluntary, living framework; does not absolve compliance with existing laws such as the PDPA.
